items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Henry Le_______ in their response, only discussing other individuals (Louis Brown, Johnny Dillman) present at the studio.

ctx.x: Now, who else was there at the same time? Was anybody else that was well known other than Eleanor Powell coming in? Any other black dancers? How about Henry Le_______?

Yeah, well, there was a fellow, the twins' brother, he was Louis Brown. He used to come down there and practice. And there was a fellow named Johnny Dillman. He's a great musician now. He's a trumpet player. He plays trumpet. But he was a dancer at that time, you know. He's a dance teacher rather. He was the one that was up on the second floor in the Billy Pierce Studio, you know.
